name: adcopilot-retail-media-plugin
description: AdCopilot Retail Media works with Amazon Ads: it reads the Amazon Ads profiles you connect, read only, and reviews them, checks Amazon Attribution on the Google Ads ads that send shoppers to Amazon, checks the Amazon Ad Tag in Google Tag Manager, reports Amazon-sourced visits in Google Analytics (GA4), and does campaign plans, headlines and ACOS math. We are an independent service provider and are not affiliated with or endorsed by Amazon.

plugins.name: adcopilot-retail-media
plugins.description: Works with Amazon Ads: reads the Amazon Ads profiles you connect, read only (campaigns, ad groups, ads, targeting, budgets, results, search terms and Amazon's suggested bids and budgets), with an audit, wasted spend, budget pacing, a period comparison and keyword ideas. Also Amazon Attribution checks on Google Ads ads that point to Amazon, Amazon Ad Tag checks in Google Tag Manager, Amazon-sourced visits in Google Analytics (GA4), Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and display ads plans, headlines and ACOS, TACOS and budget math. It changes nothing in your Amazon Ads account. We are an independent service provider and are not affiliated with or endorsed by Amazon.
